items.title: Hong Kong Action Comedy Video Prompt
items.prompt:
Subject & Characters: A 1990s Hong Kong action-comedy scene featuring two characters:
An intense male assassin dressed in a retro white suit jacket, black-and-white striped undershirt, black tie, and fingerless gloves, holding a black pistol equipped with a detachable suppressor/silencer.
A surprised young Asian woman with a short black bob haircut, wearing a bright yellow sleeveless top.
Setting & Environment: A bright, minimalist interior space featuring a bathroom and living area separated by a yellow revolving wall panel door. Clean tile walls, high contrast lighting, and a vibrant yellow color scheme.
Action & Motion Sequence:
00:00 – 00:11: Dynamic intercut shots alternating between the assassin dramatically aiming his suppressed handgun and the woman sitting casually on a toilet in the adjoining bathroom area.
00:12 – 00:25: The assassin lowers his weapon slightly and pushes against the central yellow revolving partition wall, causing it to swivel open.
00:26 – 00:38: In a comedic slapstick timing, as the yellow partition spins around, the woman stands up and walks around the rotating door into the adjacent room, while the assassin swivels into the space she just vacated—causing them to narrowly miss seeing each other.
00:39 – 00:40: The woman enters the bathroom stall from the other side and sits back down, right as the assassin turns around and points his gun through the open partition directly back at her.
Cinematography & Visual Style:
Style: 1990s Hong Kong retro action-comedy film, cinematic film grain, saturated yellow and white color palette, sharp medium shots.
Camera Movement: Fast cuts, eye-level framing, steady horizontal panning following the rotation of the revolving wall.

items.prompt:
[Reference Lock]

Use the newly generated first frame @1 as the reference for appearance and environment.

The male is an adult around 38 years old, with a buzz cut, short stubble, shirtless, wearing dark grey sports shorts with orange trim, and grey-black sneakers.

Abnormal muscle lumps already exist on his shoulders and back at the start; they do not grow during the video.

From the left scapula to the ribs is a vertical, asymmetric massive bulge; the right shoulder has smaller stacked muscle bumps.

On the surface of the left lump are two dark purple fissure-like wounds, with shriveled, irregular edges.

The lump has real weight, slightly compressing with muscle contraction, not inflating like a balloon.

No blood spraying, tissue bursting, or extra limbs.

[Style and Camera]

9:16 portrait, 12-second continuous mobile phone recording.

The cameraman stands about two meters behind and to the left of the man, shooting from chest height.

Opens with a two-thirds rear angle showing the shoulder/back lump, arms, and EZ curl bar simultaneously.

Slight hand shake, minor composition adjustments, no circling, no cuts, no slow motion.

Ordinary old gym record: flat fluorescent lights, slight noise, compression artifacts, sweat reflections, and natural motion blur.

No horror movie lighting, no background music.

[Environment and Props]

Old community basement gym, white pillars, light green wall wainscoting, worn grey floor, red training bench, dumbbell rack, and wall fan.

An adult fitness enthusiast in grey clothes continues training in the background, not watching or screaming.

The protagonist holds the same EZ curl bar with both hands, with a fixed number of black weight plates on each side.

[0-4s | Completing Bicep Curls Seriously]

The man stands firm, elbows close to body, lifting the bar from hips to chest.

Forearms bend first, then biceps tighten.

The massive back bulge slightly compresses with shoulder force, wound positions remain unchanged.

He looks down at the bar, expression strained, short exhale.

Phone adjusts slightly, keeping abnormal shoulders/back and curl action in frame.

[4-7s | Slowly Lowering]

The man controls the bar descent until arms are nearly straight.

Shoulder/back soft tissues sink and sway slightly with unloading, then stabilize.

Sweat flows down skin.

Cannot suddenly shrink back to normal physique, cannot add new lumps.

[7-10s | Ending Training]

He bends knees, leans forward, places the bar on the ground before his feet.

Weight plates touch ground first, then he releases hands.

A dull metallic clank is heard.

Phone naturally follows down slightly, then lifts back to upper body.

Man straightens up, breathing heavily.

[10-12s | Notices Being Filmed]

The man turns head to look at camera first, then rotates shoulders and torso into a more frontal stance.

Arms hang naturally, abnormal shoulder/back volume still discernible from silhouette.

He pants looking at the filmer, mouth slightly open, does not lunge at camera.

Scene ends directly.

[Live Sound]

Breathing, shoe friction, light clinking of weight plates, equipment collision, and wall fan.

No soundtrack, narration, subtitles, or monster roars.

[Continuity Constraints]

Only one protagonist, two arms, one barbell.

Abnormal muscles and wounds maintain fixed positions, no per-frame morphing.

Sequence of gripping, curling, lowering, landing, releasing is complete.

Camera stays at the same observation position, front view presented by man turning.

No attacks, tentacles, sudden transformations, or bloody bursts.

items.prompt:
[Overall Setting]

10 seconds, 9:16 vertical, realistic casual smartphone footage in a restaurant, single take.

Uploaded redrawn image serves as end-frame reference, locking the shape of the shoe-sole-shaped dried tofu, gripping position, table layout, waiter's appearance, and final composition.

[Scene & Filming Relationship]

Ordinary small Chinese restaurant, warm pendant lights, beige tables, customers eating and chatting naturally in background.

Foreground features large white bowl containing chili oil, dried tofu, noodles, and vegetables, with soup bowl, teapot, and tissue box nearby.

Seated adult man holds phone with left hand, uses two wooden chopsticks in right hand to pick food. Only picking hand enters frame; man's face and body remain off-screen.

Waiter wears black top and wine-red apron, positioned on right side across the table.

Slight handheld shake, natural indoor exposure, ordinary phone compression quality, no beauty filter, no cinematic color grading.

[Key Prop]

Only one piece of shoe-sole-shaped dried tofu: brownish-yellow, thin slice, surface coated with chili oil and scallions, clear grid pattern, outline consistent with end frame.

It is flexible food, not a real shoe sole, no shoe upper, rubber, or shoes appear.

Chopsticks grip top end of tofu, contact points accurate, bottom end hangs naturally when lifted.

[Strict Time Storyboard]

0–2s:

Camera slightly downward toward dish bowl. Man's right hand enters from left, using two wooden chopsticks to grip top end of tofu piece in bowl.

Tofu partially submerged in chili oil, outline not fully revealed yet.

2–4.5s:

Man slowly lifts chopsticks upward.

Entire tofu piece continuously extracted from bowl, first revealing top end, then grid pattern, narrowed middle section, and rounded bottom, gradually presenting complete shoe-sole shape.

Tofu sways gently, two or three drops of sauce fall back into bowl.

Camera lifts slightly with holding hand, keeping entire tofu piece within frame.

4.5–6s:

Man stops chopsticks, appearing to examine food closely, mutters suspiciously:

"This dried tofu..."

Waiter hears sound, approaches slightly from across table, gaze shifts from chopsticks to tofu.

6–9s:

Man maintains grip, gently displays tofu toward waiter, asks:

"Waiter, why does it look like a shoe sole?"

Tone natural, confused, slightly incredulous, not shouting accusations.

Waiter looks down at it, eyebrows gradually furrow, lips purse lightly, pauses, does not answer immediately.

Tofu still suspended above bowl, does not touch waiter.

9–10s:

Camera rests on complete tofu piece and waiter's puzzled reaction.

Chopsticks, tofu, utensils, and waiter positions align with end-frame reference, hold for at least one second, leaving quiet comedic pause.

[Sound]

Adult man's natural speaking voice, originating near camera.

Retain sounds of chopsticks lightly hitting bowl rim, sauce dripping, low-volume chat from neighboring tables, and clinking utensils.

No narration, no background music, no exaggerated comedy sound effects.

[Continuity & Constraints]

Must grip before lifting, tofu emerges along continuous trajectory from bowl, no teleportation, no duplication.

Maintain same shape, size, grid pattern, and color before and after lifting.

Keep two chopsticks, do not pierce food, do not deform; fingers normal.

Waiter only naturally approaches and observes, does not snatch food, does not scream prematurely.

No cuts, no sudden zoom, no slow motion, no adding shoes or other explanatory props.

Generated output must not include text, watermarks, or platform interfaces.

items.title: Realistic Selfie Video Generation
items.prompt:
[Task]

Generate a 12-second, 9:16 vertical realistic smartphone selfie video. Replicate the lying-on-bed composition, action sequence, mixed crying-and-laughing expressions, and rhythm from the reference video 'Angry Until Stomach Hurts', replacing the original character with a specified adult female.

[Reference Division and Character Locking]

Lock the face to the female portrait in reference image @0ba07db1-974c-467d-80dc-d9dffddac0ba, including facial proportions and long black hair; do not inherit the male appearance from the original video.

Lock clothing and body proportions to reference image @8149c66e-9a91-4b88-bf26-d0a764075ccf, ensuring clothes are fully worn.

Lock glasses to silver decorative glasses in reference image @d80c71c5-d330-4baf-8ecf-8b793ee0fee8: thin silver metal wireframes, open curved lower rims, transparent nose pads, small bow-tie metal coils near the bridge, and one hanging flower charm on each side. Temples rest normally on ears, eyes clearly visible. Glasses must be worn throughout, not changing into thick-rimmed glasses or display stands.

The original video only locks performance, selfie angle, actions, and rhythm.

Do not inherit the falling shot from the previous nine-grid.

[Scene and Filming]

She lies supine on white bedding, head on a white pillow, long hair naturally spread out.

Left hand holds the phone off-screen; front camera is approx. 40cm above the face, shooting downwards capturing face, shoulders, and upper body. Face occupies the main subject area.

Right hand may reach the bottom edge of the frame to press the abdomen.

One continuous take throughout; camera shakes slightly only due to holding hand, breathing, and shoulder tremors. Natural bedroom lighting, standard smartphone native quality, realistic skin texture, no beauty filters.

[Strict Timing and Performance]

0–2.8s:

Opens immediately in a state of angry crying/laughing. Brows furrowed tightly, eyes squeezed shut, mouth corners pulled horizontally, intermittently emitting "Hahaha... Ah... Haha".

Laughter carries grievance and anger; shoulders tremble lightly, head moves slightly on the pillow.

Silver flower charms sway gently with head movement; nose pads and temples remain fitted to the face.

2.8–5.8s:

She stops to inhale, barely opens eyes to look at the screen, brows still furrowed, mouth corners turned down, speaking with anger and grievance:

"Family, I'm so angry my stomach hurts."

As she says the second half, right hand presses abdomen, head turns to the side, eyes squeeze shut again. Phone shakes slightly with body tremors, face remains clearly readable.

5.8–9.3s:

She tries to catch her breath but emits broken "Hahaha... Ah..."

Mouth opens, briefly purses, then opens again, showing a reaction wanting to laugh yet cry. Brows tighten, nostrils flare slightly, chin trembles, occasionally showing teeth.

Head returns from side position to center of pillow, right hand continues pressing abdomen. Glasses move with head, flower charms sway naturally.

9.3–12s:

Briefly opens eyes looking at screen, angrily saying:

"I'm so angry I could die."

Then closes eyes, scrunches nose, reveals mixed crying/laughing expression, ending with a short bitter laugh and exhale.

Remains lying in place, does not get up, adds no other plot.

[Audio]

Natural adult female voice, close-range phone recording, lip-sync with dialogue.

Intermittent laughter, with inhales and breathy sounds; emotion is a mix of anger, grievance, and bitter laughter.

Slight pillow rustling, fabric friction, and indoor ambient noise; no narration, no background music.

If generation tool supports reference video audio, prioritize matching pauses, laughter, and speech rhythm of the original clip.

[Key Requirements]

Retain exaggerated eye-squeezing, brow-furrowing, mouth-opening, and head-shaking from original; must not become pretty smile or calm talking-head.

Maintain same character identity even when expressions distort features.

Glasses structure, number of flowers, clothing, hairstyle, bed, and lighting consistent throughout.

No face swapping, no floating glasses or clipping through skin, no extra flower charms, no extra arms or abnormal fingers.

No cuts, no falling, no rolling camera angles, no slow motion, no cinematic camera moves.

Do not add subtitles, screenshot stickers, watermarks, or platform UI to generated frames.

0-4 seconds: Extremely slow push-in shot from a medium shot of the desktop to a close-up of the two people's side profiles sitting side-by-side. A pure girl in a summer school uniform is focused on writing notes with her head down, long black hair and stray hairs by her ears are gently lifted by a slight breeze, long eyelashes cast subtle shadows, skin is naturally pink and tender, a slight, unintentional upturn of the corner of her mouth in concentration, light and even breathing.
4-9 seconds: Switch to a close-up of the boy. His school uniform collar is slightly loose, he props his elbow on the desk and secretly turns his head to gaze at her, his eyes filled with gentle, restrained affection and tenderness, pupils slightly dilated, his Adam's apple gently rolls. Suddenly noticing her pen pause, he quickly and flusteredly turns his head to pretend to look at his own notes, his earlobes quickly turn slightly red, his fingertips tremble slightly as he grips the pen, occasionally glancing at her from under his bangs, his breathing is slightly disordered, and his lips are tightly pressed in an effort to remain calm.
9-15 seconds: Extreme close-up of both faces in the same frame, slow-motion eyes suddenly meet: the girl slowly turns her head, first showing a dazed surprise, then quickly and shyly lowers her head for 0.3 seconds, gently biting her lower lip, her cheeks and earlobes instantly bloom with cherry blossom pink, her moist eyelashes timidly look up to meet his gaze again, while softly and shyly whispering, "...What are you looking at?"; the boy freezes completely, his pupils dilate, and he is stunned for 0.4 seconds, then flusteredly and quietly stutters in response, "N-nothing...". The girl whispers even quieter, biting her lip and peeking at him again, continuing to whisper, "...Liar.". The boy pauses, then gently sighs and whispers, "...Just looking at you.", the corner of his mouth slowly curls up into a shy, gentle, crooked smile, fine lines appear at the corners of his eyes, and his breathing noticeably deepens. An invisible current seems to pull the ambiguous tension between their faces, sharing each other's breathing temperature, the background completely melts into layers of creamy, dreamy light spots, warm halos, and fine air particles.
Lip synchronization is natural and precise, emotional micro-tremors and breathing are synchronized, dialogue is low-energy whispering with a shy tone, natural short pauses between 200-400 milliseconds, the mouth only moves slightly when speaking, without exaggeration or robotic feel, perfect natural lip-sync and emotional authenticity.
Overall Sound Effects: Distant summer cicada chirping faintly, the soft scratching sound of the pen touching the paper, the almost inaudible low-frequency pulse of their heartbeats, finally fading into a very light, airy piano. The dialogue is completely naturally integrated into the scene as whispers, the girl's voice is soft and shy, the boy transitions from flustered stuttering to gentle.
Character identity is maintained throughout, real subtle head tilts, eye movements, and breathing synchronization, no text, watermarks, or subtitles, pure Japanese style youth secret crush heart-fluttering suspense.

items.title: Hollywood Haute Couture Fantasy Video Prompt
items.prompt: [Style] Hollywood Haute Couture Fantasy blockbuster, 8K ultra-clear, Photorealistic, High-fashion Editorial Style, Unreal Engine 5 fluid rendering, visual illusion. [Duration] 15 seconds. [Scene] An endless, real-life Salar de Uyuni (Sky Mirror) salt flat. The sky is filled with oppressive dark clouds, and the ground perfectly reflects everything like a mirror, with the overall picture presenting a minimalist, cool tone. [00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Haute Couture Entrance and Porcelain Skin. Camera position: Extremely low-angle upward shot, ultra-telephoto lens zoom-in. Action: An Asian female model with a highly recognizable, high-fashion face walks coolly on the water surface. Effect: She is wearing not fabric, but a long dress made of flowing, real Liquid Blue-and-White Porcelain. As she walks, the skirt makes a crisp collision sound like real ceramic, with a flowing luster on the surface. The traditional blue-and-white patterns move across the white porcelain-textured skirt as if alive. [00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Physical Shattering and Ink-wash Descent. Camera position: Extreme close-up of the face, focus rapidly pulls back. Action: The model suddenly stops, stares coldly at the camera, and snaps her fingers crisply. Effect: The moment the fingers snap, her blue-and-white porcelain dress does not fall, but instantly explodes into thousands of extremely photorealistic Ink-wash Swallows. These swallows carry real water droplets and ink marks, dragging black fluid afterimages in the air, spinning frantically around her. [00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Dimensional Dissolution and Abyss Reflection. Camera position: High-altitude overhead shot, camera rapidly rotates and descends. Action: The swarm of ink-wash swallows plunges into the mirrored lake water beneath the model's feet. Effect: The surface tension of the originally solid salt lake instantly disappears. The entire extremely realistic world begins to violently bleed and dissolve like concentrated ink dropped into clear water. The real dark clouds and the model's figure transform entirely into an extremely grand 3D Fluid Ink Vortex, completely swallowing the camera into a black and white interwoven abyss.
